description: Estimate FME Flow Hosted costs from Safe Software's published pricing (USD): annual plan versus pay-as-you-go, including instance hours, disk storage, backups and data transfer. Give an instance size (standard, professional, select, premium, enterprise) or the number of parallel jobs to size it. Also returns the break-even point and contact details.

data_gb.description: Data stored on the FME Flow data disk in GB; backups are charged on this (default 5).

disk_gb.description: Total disk in GB (minimum and default 40).

engines.description: FME engines you plan to run (engines are unlimited; about one per core is recommended).

hours_per_month.description: Hours the instance runs each month; 730 = always on (default).

in_region_gb_per_month.description: Data transferred within the same AWS region per month in GB (default 0).

instance_size.description: standard (2 cores, 8 GB), professional (4, 16 GB), select (8, 32 GB), premium (16, 64 GB) or enterprise (48, 192 GB).

locale.description: Website language: en-gb (English, UK), nl-nl (Dutch), be-nl (Flemish, Belgium) or fr-fr (French). Default en-gb.

outbound_gb_per_month.description: Data sent to the internet per month in GB (default 10).

parallel_jobs.description: Jobs to run at the same time; used to choose a size when instance_size is not given.

name: estimate_fme_flow_hosted_cost
title: FME Flow Hosted cost calculator
